style.backgroundSystem: flat sage-green #7CA276 screens alternating with cream #F6EADC screens and one mint #C9E6D2 screen; every screen is closed by a solid footer kicker band in sage-green #7CA276 or cream #F6EADC that carries one letter-spaced uppercase English label at the left, a three-line hamburger mark at the right and a single hairline rule between them; packshots and infographic blocks sit on clean white #FFFFFF panels with 8px corner radius
style.direction: editorial sage-green pet nutrition detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: deep-blue #1D5A8F rounded pill labels tethered to thin hairline leader lines, thin-outlined capsule sub-badges, hairline ruled spec rows and bordered table grids, small solid dot markers, three-line hamburger glyph #2E2E2E in the footer band; no paw prints, no cartoon clouds, no medical or veterinary marks
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio key from the upper left at 5000K-5500K with a light bounce fill, low contrast, gentle falloff, soft contact shadows only and never harsh speculars; scene screens use warm window light from the left at 5200K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent editorial pet-nutrition ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page image set; fixed palette of sage-green panel #7CA276, cream panel #F6EADC, one mint panel #C9E6D2, clean white cards #FFFFFF, deep-blue capsule accents #1D5A8F and charcoal text #2E2E2E; neutral daylight temperature with warm oak accents; heavy modern Chinese sans with one headline weight per screen, letter-spaced uppercase English kicker labels and all Chinese copy carried as placeholders in corner brackets; background system of flat sage-green and cream screens alternating, each screen closed by a solid footer kicker band carrying an uppercase English label at the left, a three-line hamburger mark at the right and one hairline rule between them; soft diffused studio key from the upper left at 5000K-5500K with a light bounce fill, low contrast and soft contact shadows only; infographic components of deep-blue #1D5A8F rounded pill labels on thin hairline leader lines, thin-outlined capsule sub-badges, ruled spec rows and bordered grids on 8px-cornered white cards; stand-up food pouch held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle with its die-cut handle visible and its gusseted base grounded, true matte print finish; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no paw or cartoon iconography, no medical iconography.
noDrift: no missing footer kicker band on any screen
no paw, cartoon or hand-drawn iconography
no medical crosses, shields, organs or body diagrams
no photoreal 3D drift away from the flat editorial panels
style.presentationRules: the stand-up food pouch is always shown at the same slight 3/4 hero angle with its die-cut carry handle visible and its gusseted base grounded on the surface, matte laminate print true to the reference and never restyled; the floral-rimmed bowl stays at the pouch lower right at a fixed relative scale; kibble is rendered only as generic round-flat discs in #7A5236 without implying any recipe; dogs appear only cropped above the neck, from behind or turned away so no individual animal reads as identifiable and no breed is legible; one product unit per screen unless the screen is explicitly a staged sequence
style.surfaceSystem: light oak tabletop and floor #DDAE72, matte cream board #F6EADC, brushed stainless bowl rim with a small floral-print skirt #FFFFFF holding matte kibble discs in #7A5236, plain plaster wall in sage-green #7CA276 with one peach curtain column #E9C8A6 at the frame edge
style.typography: heavy modern Chinese sans, one headline weight per screen plus one light body weight; Chinese headline 30-44pt, capsule sub-label 16-20pt, pill feature label 18pt, spec row label 16pt, letter-spaced uppercase English kicker 12pt in the footer band; headline in #FFFFFF on sage screens and in #2E2E2E on cream and mint screens; all copy carried as placeholders wrapped in corner brackets
